name: four-hour-block-hourly-spacing-intermediate-reversion
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis (13 consecutive negative static-mix runs as of 2026-10-07). 2026-10-07 found the block/spacing curve turns over past 8h: 8h block / 1h spacing with rsi60/bb90 had the smallest deficit yet (-0.250 Sharpe @500k, -0.057 @5M) while 24h/24h was worse (-2.03 @500k). The 4h side of the peak has only been measured with 4h spacing (four-hour-block-four-hour-spacing, four-hour-throttle-intermediate-reversion), never with hourly drift correction inside the block. This maps the lower flank of the curve with spacing held at 1h, per lead #2 of the 2026-10-07 report.
